title: Pwn2Own Ireland 2026 - The Full Schedule
content_md: Fáilte! Pwn2Own Ireland 2026 has arrived in Cork, and the world's top security researchers are ready. We've got more phone entries than we've ever had, and more than 60 entries total. Earlier today, we held the random draw to determine attempt order. Below is the official schedule. All times are Irish Standard Time (IST) and may change as the competition progresses. You can find our live leaderboard here . This will be updated throughout the day. Jump to: Day One Day Two Day Three DAY ONE Tuesday, October 6 - 9:30 AM Nguyen Thanh Dat ( @rewhiles ) of Viettel Cyber Security ( @vcslab ) targeting Samsung Galaxy S26 - Remote in the Mobile Phone category for a total of $50,000 and 5 Master of Pwn points @_McCaulay targeting Sonos Era 300 in the Smart Home category for a total of $50,000 and 5 Master of Pwn points Taisic Yun ( @taisic_ ) of Xint ( @xint_official ) targeting LiteLLM in the AI Infrastructure category for a total of $40,000 and 4 Master of Pwn points Ikotas Labs, Inc. targeting Brother MFC-L8970CDW in the Printers category for a total of $20,000 and 2 Master of Pwn points Tuesday, October 6 - 11:15 AM HaeJung Yang ( @haehaeYang ), and ByungYoung Yi ( @yibarrack ) of Out of Bounds ( @oobs_io )
